decision: Deletion of lap time (1:36.457) as per Article 31.4 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
event_name: Date 20 October 2018 Time 16:54 2018 UNITED STATES GRAND PRIX 18 - 21 October 2018 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Car 10 left the track at turn 19.
offence: Breach of Article 27.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: Deletion of lap time (1:36.457) as per Article 31.4 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: Car 10 left the track in turn 19 by crossing the kerb on the exit of the turn, with no part of the car remaining in contact with the red and white section of the kerb (item 10.1 of Race Director's directive, document 17). By doing that, car 10 was deemed to have gained an advantage.
rules_referenced: Article 27.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
Article 31.4 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
